entities.summary: "Did It On'em" is a song by rapper Nicki Minaj from her debut studio album, Pink Friday (2010). It was released on April 7, 2011 by Young Money and Cash Money as the sixth single from the album. It was written by Minaj, producer Shondrae "Bangladesh" Crawford, and J. Ellington.
